subject: MAP: Evaluation milestones, TPM glidepath & pricing triggers
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusai.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratusai.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & rough consumption profile

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looks promising for our inference-heavy workflows. As we discussed with Ben, Stratus wants to lock a clear MAP that ties evaluation milestones to commercial commitments so we can justify the pilot cost internally and get procurement moving.

High-level ask: can you provide a draft MAP that includes:
- A 30-day evaluation (POC) with a restrained tokens allocation for feature validation
- A 3-month ramp with monthly TPM targets we can commit to for discounts
- Pricing tiers and discount triggers tied to cumulative monthly commits
- Terms around rollover or true-up for months we under/overperform

To give you a baseline, our rough usage profile today is: 100M tokens/month for research, but production workloads could start at ~500M TPM and scale to 2.5B TPM if the POC goes well. Procurement asked for specific thresholds so they can model the spend.

Can you send a proposed glidepath and the pricing triggers you typically use? We also need a timeline to close — ideally before Dec 18 so our Q4 budget can be allocated.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of ML Platforms
Stratus AI

--
Attachment: stratus-prod-usage-estimate.csv (csv, 14 KB)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & rough consumption profile

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the usage baseline. I put together a draft MAP and a pricing glidepath attached (see 2026-11-02_MAP-proposal-v1.pdf and redwood-pricing-ladder-11-26.xlsx). Summary below so Procurement can see the key decision points quickly.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) POC / Eval (30 days) — evaluation allocation 250M TPM cap, no overage billing. Goal: validate latency, token quality and prefix caching coverage. Acceptance: 3 pre-agreed prompt families pass quality thresholds.
2) Initial ramp (months 1–3 post-POC) — commit to a monthly floor of 500M TPM in month 1, 1.0B TPM in month 2, 1.75B TPM in month 3.
3) Steady-state cadence (months 4–12) — commit to a minimum monthly TPM of 2.5B, with quarterly reviews to rebase the glidepath.

Pricing triggers and discounts:
- Base list price X per 1M tokens.
- 10% discount kicks in at a 3-month cumulative commit >= 4.5B TPM.
- 18% discount at cumulative 12-month commit >= 24B TPM.
- Accelerator credits: if monthly usage exceeds committed TPM by >=25% for three consecutive months, Redwood provides a temporary 5% credit applied to overage month while we discuss permanent re-tiering.

True-up and rollover: 10% of unused committed tokens per quarter can roll forward; true-up billed at contracted overage rate with cap. Cancellation: 60-day notice with pro rata refund on unused committed spend for dedicated capacity.

Timeline to close: If Stratus signs the MAP + order form by Dec 18, we can start the POC week of Jan 4 and target a production handoff by end of March.

Open items where we need your input:
- Confirm whether TPM in your modeling = tokens per month (you used TPM colloquially) — we assumed TPM = tokens/month for pricing.
- Is your finance team comfortable with quarterly roll-forwards rather than monthly?
- Any nonstandard security/compliance asks that would impact timeline?

Ben (cc'd) will own commercial confirmation; Marissa will support contracting. I'll await Procurement's feedback and can run a short exec summary for your CFO if needed.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachments: 2026-11-02_MAP-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf, 87 KB), redwood-pricing-ladder-11-26.xlsx (xlsx, 45 KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusai.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratusai.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & rough consumption profile

Mina — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear tiers. A few notes from Procurement/Finance after an internal review:

1) The POC allocation at 250M TPM is fine, but Procurement wants a 45-day eval window (internal review cycle). Can you extend the POC to 45 days with the same no-overage protection?

2) Ramp smoothing: committing to 500M then 1.0B then 1.75B feels like a big step for us operationally. Can we propose a smoother cadence: 400M -> 750M -> 1.25B for months 1–3, with a planned re-eval at month 3 to firm up months 4–6? The commercial discount triggers can remain tied to cumulative commits instead of rigid monthly floors.

3) We need clearer language on how overages are handled month-to-month and how credits apply — Procurement flagged that temporary credits are hard to model. Could you add a worked example showing a 30% overage in month 2 and how the credit/true-up plays out?

4) Timeline: Dec 18 is tight for us given procurement board schedules. Our latest ask is to aim for sign by Dec 22; can Redwood accept that and still meet a Jan 4 POC start?

If you can send a revised MAP draft reflecting the 45-day POC, the smoother ramp, and the worked example, Procurement can re-run the model and get back with legal comments.

Regards,
Elena

--
Forwarded attachment: stratus-proc-comments-11-05.docx (docx, 12 KB)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & rough consumption profile

Elena —

Thanks for the procurement notes and the proposed smoothing — that all seems reasonable. We've updated the MAP and attached a revised proposal (2026-11-30_MAP-proposal-v2.pdf) that incorporates:

- POC extended to 45 days at 250M TPM cap, no overage billing during evaluation.
- Smoothed ramp: month 1 = 400M TPM, month 2 = 750M TPM, month 3 = 1.25B TPM. Month 4+ target 2.5B TPM steady-state with quarterly rebase.
- Pricing: kept cumulative discount triggers aligned to cumulative commits (3-month and 12-month buckets).
- Worked example: month 2 shows a 30% overage vs committed — we illustrate billing at overage rate, a 5% temporary credit applied to that month's overage line item, and how the credit posts to the next invoice while the account team evaluates re-tiering.

On timing: Dec 22 signing is acceptable — we'll engage Legal immediately upon receiving Procurement's redlines and aim to hold the POC kickoff call Jan 4. Marissa, can your team prepare the order form and a short SOW template so procurement has a single doc to return? Jordan, please queue a finance-friendly worked-example spreadsheet in the Drive link (copied to related_links).

I'll wait for the redlines and will schedule a 30-minute sync with your Procurement lead next week if helpful.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
